payload.reason: The evidence discusses various factors influencing glacier distribution, including spatial variability in precipitation, topography, and other climatic variables such as cloudiness and humidity.

claims.text: Spatial variability in precipitation due to topography influences glacier extent.
Local topography affects glacier sensitivity to climate, complicating predictions of glacier behavior.
Factors such as precipitation type, cloudiness, humidity, and sublimation can influence glacier accumulation and melt.
